scoringNotes: Each section (Reading & Writing, and Math) is scored on a 200-800 scale; the two sections combine for a total SAT score of 400-1600. The Reading & Writing section is module-adaptive: Module 2 difficulty (easier or harder version) is selected based on performance in Module 1. Scores are equated across test forms using an equating process so that a given score represents consistent performance regardless of the test date.

specialPolicies.calculatorPolicy: No calculator is relevant. The Reading & Writing section contains no calculator-dependent questions.
specialPolicies.deliveryNotes: Fully digital exam delivered in the Bluebook app. Module-adaptive: Module 2 difficulty (higher or lower difficulty version) is determined by Module 1 performance. Passages are short (25-150 words) with exactly one question per passage.
